findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/ParametricIntegral.lean:349 `theorem hasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn_integral_of_le_bound`; already used the same way in TauCeti/Analysis/Pseudodifferential/Kernel.lean:318 (`contDiff_quantizationKernel_of_bound`).
findings.fix: Apply `hasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn_integral_of_le_bound` on `Metric.ball p₀ 1` with `p := fun p η ↦ ftaylorSeries ℝ (fun q ↦ g η • f (q.1, q.2 - (2*π)•η)) p` and `bound i η := C_i * (2^(|s_i|/2) * 2^|s_i| * ⟨p₀.2⟩^(s_i)) * (⟨2πη⟩^|s_i| * ‖g η‖)` from `HasLocalGrowth f i`. This gives `ContDiff` and `iteratedFDeriv (shiftIntegral g f) = ∫ g η • iteratedFDeriv f (·, · - 2πη)` in one step; get `mixedDeriv_shiftIntegral` from it via `mixedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv`.
findings.issue: `contDiff_shiftIntegral` and `iteratedFDerivAlong_shiftIntegral` (plus `hasFDerivAt_shiftIntegral`, `fderiv_shiftIntegral_apply`, `HasLocalGrowth.fderiv_apply`, `HasLocalGrowth.bound_zero/bound_one`, `continuous_shiftIntegral`) re-derive smoothness of a parametric integral by induction on one-step `hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le`.

findings.evidence: code/TauCeti/Analysis/Calculus/CoordinateDeriv.lean:187-203 `norm_le_sum_single` uses the same `opNorm_le_bound`/`map_sum`/`map_smul_univ`/`norm_prod`/`PiLp.norm_apply_le` chain as the new lemma at :713.
findings.fix: Factor one lemma for a finite family `e : ι → E` with coordinates `c : E → ι → ℝ` such that `v = ∑ l, c v l • e l` and `‖c v l‖ ≤ ‖v‖`, concluding `‖M‖ ≤ ∑ r : Fin k → ι, ‖M (e ∘ r)‖`. Derive both `norm_le_sum_single` and the mixed-direction case from it.
findings.issue: `ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_le_sum_mixedDirection` copies the proof of the existing `ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_le_sum_single` (expand each argument in a coordinate family, `M.map_sum`, `map_smul_univ`, bound each coordinate by `‖v‖`), changing only the index type and the family.

findings.evidence: grep `integral_fourierChar_mul_fourier` in code/TauCeti finds only its declaration (Fourier.lean:570) and the docstring list entry (Fourier.lean:95); mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Fourier/Notation.lean:211 `fourierInv_fourier_eq`.
findings.fix: Delete it. Where needed, use `FourierTransform.fourierInv_fourier_eq` with `fourierInv_coe, Real.fourierInv_eq`, as `integral_fourier_eq_apply_zero` already does.
findings.issue: `SchwartzMap.integral_fourierChar_mul_fourier` is a thin restatement of `fourierInv_fourier_eq` with `Real.fourierInv_eq` unfolded, and nothing uses it (the quantization proof goes through `fourier_smulLeftCLM_sub_apply`).

summary: The new kernel-cutoff material is mostly new, but `contDiff_shiftIntegral`/`iteratedFDerivAlong_shiftIntegral` hand-roll all-orders differentiation under the integral that Mathlib's `hasFTaylorSeriesUpToOn_integral_of_le_bound` provides (and TauCeti already uses that way). There is also a near-clone of `norm_le_sum_single` and an unused Fourier-inversion wrapper.
